text:
emma: Quick alert 1: customers hitting v1 when the new deprecation badge is shown. Causes retries from old SDKs and bumps v1 quotas. Thoughts?
raj: Logs: missing `x-api-version` plus `X-Retry: true` headers. Some SDKs re-POST without carrying headers.
dina: We can change badge behavior: make it non-interruptive and add explicit copy: 'Preserve headers to avoid duplicate requests'. Fastest fix is toggle to soft-badge.
mike: Billing concern: duplicates hit v1 quota and create noisy invoices. We should tag runtime-detected retries so billing can reconcile.
jord: Runtime small fix: detect duplicate client_request_id within 10s and prefer v2 when UA indicates redwood-sdk>=1.4.0. Emit `X-Compat-Flag: dedupe` so billing can zero-rate if needed. Gate via FF.
raj: Pseudorule: if missing header and recent duplicate and ua ok -> route v2, inject tag, sample body for observability.
dina: I'll add a console toggle under Routing > Deprecations: "Soft badge (non-retry)" default ON, and a tenant-level opt-in "auto-compat" for those that want automatic safe fallthrough.
mike: For rollout, billing will accept compat tag and apply temporary credit policy for 7 days. Need a reconciliation query (I'll ship).
emma: Rollout plan: 1) Toggle badge to soft now; 2) Ship FF + runtime rule to canary tenants; 3) Expand if stable. Window: today 16:00-17:30 PT.
console-bot: feature_flag created: compat_dedupe_v2 by raj at 1767772488
raj: Adding alerts: spike in v1-fallback rate, v2 latency tail, and doubled token counts per-tenant. If any fire, FF off.
emma: Great, owners: Dina (console toggle), Raj (runtime FF), Mike (billing tag + credits), Jord (observability). Thanks all.
